title: Arithmetic Symmetry in Ideal Prouhet-Tarry-Escott Solutions
summary: Motivated in part by anomaly cancellation for integral charge spectra in chiral gauge theory, we study the symmetric locus in the ideal degree-three Prouhet-Tarry-Escott problem. A symmetric integer solution is one whose entries are paired about a common center $c\in \frac12\mathbb Z$. This symmetry reduces the problem to a sum-of-two-squares equation, $x^2+y^2=u^2+v^2$, in integer variables, subject to the appropriate parity conditions.
